text: Can a Z3 phase ride on the vacuum clock, or does the clock rule out the ground state physics needs?
description:
OP-03: a ground state for a vacuum that flashes.

Known: the empty state is not fixed, because calm and calm make a love and a fear. Under the pair table alone it is a global period-three oscillation (E-FND-0080). Under the committed turning weave, which runs that pair clock inside a 24-beat schedule, it recurs at beat 24 and not before (E-FND-0118). Read as a condensate, the committed knit's vacuum has period 24, leaves the same 2 lines empty at all 24 birth phases, and is carried to itself by the knit's reversal. It respects only the charge U(1) (2 of 9! two-vibe maps respect SU(2)): a Higgs-like vacuum without a Higgs mechanism. The only free lone vibes are the 2 leading ends of the empty lines (E-FRC-0143). The adopted knit runs a different vacuum, the coset-union hub vacuum chosen on 2026-09-26: it recurs exactly every 6 beats on the side-4 box, makes and unmakes pairs, and is one causal component (E-RLT-0093, E-FND-0146).

Unknown: whether this clock is one the physics can use or a defect of the knit.

Why it matters: it changes what a single particle means in the program.

Scope: a small theoretical question, then one experiment.

Skills: statistical mechanics, discrete dynamics.

Where to start: test/experiment/foundations/rule-has-no-amplitudes.ts; test/experiment/gauge/center-automaton.ts.

The claims it would move: R-FND-0001, R-FRC-0002.

Evidence named: E-FND-0080, E-FND-0118, E-FRC-0143, E-RLT-0093, E-FND-0146.
